brief:
# Build: kill-patches-pilot (Urgent profile)

Requested by Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): "Patches is dead. Delete it, all references. Build Pilot dead, same thing. Delete it. All references." GO given. Do it now.

## First
- Register in the Urgent profile via the orchestrator CLI (id `kill-patches-pilot`, branch claude/kill-patches-pilot) + banner entry. Never hand-edit store.json (orch-live-sync is running). Other parallel builds: notes-vault, headless-tabs, whats-new-banner, amberx-backup-fix.

## Remove from this repo (AmberX-AXF), everything
- Patches: apps/patches-web, the Patches Android app/module, any patches plugin/wrapper code, patches-specific assets, banners, boilerplates, catalog/tracker entries, CI workflow jobs and deploy steps, rebake targets, demo/walkthrough chapters or captions mentioning it, help packs, docs (_claude/memory/docs/patches-*, rebuilds/patches-*), tracker.json rows.
- Build Pilot: any build-pilot app/plugin/tab/integration code, Dev Console or axHub hooks into it, catalog/docs/help/walkthrough references.
- Rules/instructions: rewrite every rule that depends on Patches. In particular the hub-sync rule that "Console and Pilot can only run inside Patches (never standalone)" -> Console runs standalone; Pilot is gone. Update RULES.md (repo + shared), CLAUDE.md, THREADS.md (one closing line, don't rewrite history), STATUS, decisions.md (add a decision entry: Patches and Build Pilot retired Nov 3 2026; don't delete old decision text, mark superseded).
- Orchestrator store: archive every build whose subject is Patches or Build Pilot (via CLI), note "retired Nov 3 2026". Pending queue too.
- grep -ri 'patches\|build.pilot\|build-pilot\|buildpilot' across the repo afterward; the only hits left may be historical log lines and the decision entry. Note: don't confuse with generic words like 'patch' / 'patching' / 'autopilot' / PilotX (separate app).
- Everything must still build: tsc, vite builds of every remaining app, check-theme/check-controls, plugin lifecycle, CI block. Open the PR.

## Remove from the VPS (live)
- Before removing anything: snapshot each container's volumes/data + its Coolify app config to /root/archive/retired-2026-11-03/ (tar.gz), so it's recoverable.
- Stop and remove the `patches-web` and `build-pilot` containers and their Coolify applications (Coolify API/UI so they don't come back on redeploy), Traefik routes/domains, any cron/systemd units, images.
- axHub projects tree: remove /projects/patches, /projects/patches-web (and any build-pilot project) via the hub memory API so versions stay recoverable; remove them from shared/memory/projects.md.
- axHub repo: references to Patches/Build Pilot (services, examples, docs, approvals) -> clone /root/axHub fresh on branch claude/kill-patches-pilot, remove them, open a PR there too.
- GitHub repo MossesX/Build-Pilot: ARCHIVE it (read-only), do not delete; deleting a repo is irreversible and Brett can delete it in one click later. Say so in the report.

## Report
`_claude/builds/reports/kill-patches-pilot.md`: everything removed (paths, containers, apps, domains), where the archive is, PR links. Mark each step done through the store as you go. Commits clean and professional.

steps.text: Remove Patches apps (apps/patches, apps/patches-web) and Build Pilot code/integration from the repo
Remove Patches/Pilot from framework, console, other apps, CI workflows, deploy, catalog, tracker
Archive Patches/Pilot builds in the store and pending lists
Builds and checks pass (tsc, vite, check-theme/controls, lifecycle); open PR
VPS: snapshot then remove patches-web/build-pilot containers, Coolify apps, routes, images
axHub: remove /projects trees + projects.md entries; axHub repo PR; archive MossesX/Build-Pilot

open: s7: axHub: remove /projects trees + projects.md entries; axHub repo PR; archive MossesX/Build-Pilot

Archive MossesX/Build-Pilot — not done: the token on the VPS can't change repo settings (403) and the GitHub App isn't set up. One tap: github.com/MossesX/Build-Pilot → Settings → Danger Zone → Archive this repository. Archive, not delete: deleting is irreversible; he can delete it in one click later.

axHub projects `/projects/patches` and `/projects/patches-web` — snapshotted, not deleted: this headless session has no axHub MCP access, and hub deletes must go through axHub as a veto call (`axhub.memory_*`) so versions stay recoverable. `shared/memory/projects.md` never listed them. No build-pilot project existed.
DNS `patches` and `pilot` A records on amberxai.com — still there (Hostinger connector not authorized here).
Live axHub env `AXHUB_EMBED_FRAME_ANCESTORS` still names `https://patches.amberxai.com` — harmless (nothing serves it); drop it on the next hub redeploy.
